jobs.occupation: Postdoc | Human In Vitro Models of Lung Disease  - Endothelial Biology in Chronic Lung Diseases (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
We are seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Scientist to join the Tech Innovation Lab within Immunology & Respiratory Research at Boehringer Ingelheim.
This role focuses on advancing human-relevant in vitro models of lung disease (ILD and COPD) with a strong emphasis on endothelial biology and vascular heterogeneity.
The first objective of the project is to develop robust isolation strategies to distinguish lymphatic versus blood endothelial cells from human lung tissues and integrate clean endothelial cell populations into next-generation in vitro systems.
Importantly, the project aims to ultimately develop human proof-of-concept co-culture models to establish causal links between blood endothelial dysfunction and fibrosis-relevant readouts.
This position is particularly suited for candidates interested in bridging advanced model development with mechanistic disease biology in a translational setting.
Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.
To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.
Tasks & responsibilities

- You will develop and optimize novel isolation workflows to separate blood vascular endothelial cells (BECs) & lymphatic endothelial cells (LECs) from human lung tissue
- Moreover, you will establish and validate phenotypic and functional characterization pipelines including marker-based profiling at gene and protein level & functional assays (e.g., barrier function, transport, inflammatory activation, etc.)
- In addition, you will integrate endothelial subtypes into advanced in vitro models, including 3D organoid and multi-lineage systems, endothelial-centered co-cultures & microphysiological systems
- Furthermore, you will Investigate vascular subtype-specific mechanisms in ILD and COPD, including barrier integrity and permeability, inflammatory and immune signaling & downstream tissue remodeling processes.
- You will additionally generate and interpret high-dimensional datasets (e.g., transcriptomics, imaging, secretome profiling)
- We expect you to contribute to early discovery and translational efforts by enabling subtype-resolved biology and delivering disease-relevant human model systems suitable for drug discovery

Requirements

- Excellent PhD in vascular biology, cell biology, immunology, pulmonary biology, or a related field
- Strong experience with primary human cell isolation and culture
- Hands-on experience with cell sorting techniques (FACS/MACS) is essential
- Experience in advanced cell culture systems (e.g., organoids, co-cultures, organ-on-chip) is highly desirable
- Expertise in endothelial biology is a plus
- Familiarity with single-cell or spatial omics approaches is an advantage
- Strong problem-solving mindset and interest in method development and innovation
- Ability to work in a multidisciplinary team within an industry research environment
- Excellent communication skills in English
- Ability to communicate complex biological concepts in a clear and accessible manner

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from people with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Step 3: On-site interviews beginning of October

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

You assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions

- 
You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives

- 
You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools

- 
You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility

- 
You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions

- 
You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices

- 
You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language

- 
You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team members

Qualifikationen

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- 
You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field

- 
You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development

- 
You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)

- 
You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps

- 
You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog

-

- 
You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure

jobs.occupation: Head of Structures (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for an experienced and passionate Head of Structures to lead and further develop our growing structures team.In this role, you will take overall technicalresponsibility for the structural development of our VTOL aircrafts, fro initial concepts and structural architecture through detailed design, analysis, manufacturing support and structural testing.You will define the structural strategy, make key technical decisions and ensure that lightweight, robust, manufacturable and certifiable structures are developed inline with the overall aircraft and programme objectives. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of structural design and analysis engineers while remaining closely involved in design reviews, prototype manufacturing, aircraft integration and structural testing.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• You lead and further develop the structures team and take overall technical responsibility for the aircraft structure, from preliminary design through detailed design, manufacturing, testing and flight operations
• You define and maintain the structural architecture, load paths, design principles and material concepts and lead the development of primary and secondary structures, including fuselage, wings, empennage, propulsion-supporting structures, landing gear interfaces and system installations
• You define structural requirements, verification methods, test strategies and acceptance criteria and coordinate analyses covering strength, stiffness, stability, fatigue, damage tolerance, vibration and dynamic behaviour
• You plan, review and support coupon, component, subassembly and full-scale structural tests and ensure compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements, certification objectives and internal development processes
• You coordinate closely with Loads, Flight Physics, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, Testing, Certification and Quality to develop lightweight, robust, manufacturable and integrated structural solutions.
• You review and approve structural concepts, calculations, drawings, reports and test documentation and manage structural risks, deviations, design changes and corrective actions
• You actively support prototype manufacturing, structural assembly, aircraft integration, ground and flight testing and the resolution of practical issues, structural findings, damage or failures directly on the hardware
• You establish and continuously improve engineering processes, methods, tools and documentation standards and support the selection and coordination of external development and manufacturing partners
• You translate the structural development roadmap into clear priorities and responsibilities and support the growth of the team through recruiting, onboarding, mentoring and technical development

WHAT YOU BRING
• You hold an academic degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering or a comparable technical course of study
• Several years of professional experience in aircraft structures, including responsibility for structural design, analysis or verification, form part of your background
• Strong experience in the development of lightweight aircraft structures from initial concept through detailed design and testing is something you bring to the table
• You have extensive knowledge of composite, metallic and sandwich structures, including relevant manufacturing and joining technologies
• Structural mechanics, load paths, finite element analysis, strength, stability, fatigue and structural testing form part of your technical expertise
• You bring strong hands-on experience in the manufacturing, assembly, modification, repair or testing of aircraft structures and prototypes
• You are comfortable working directly with prototypes and hardware and enjoy resolving practical structural and integration challenges together with the workshop and test teams
• Leading a multidisciplinary engineering team while remaining technically and practically involved is something you are capable of
• You are able to make technical decisions and balance weight, performance, safety, manufacturability, cost and schedule
• Target-oriented self-management comes naturally to you, along with a structured and pragmatic working style
• Strong problem-solving, communication, leadership and technical writing skills complete your profile.
• Fluent English rounds out your qualifications

The following would further strengthen your application:
• Experience with the structural development of VTOL aircraft, helicopters, fixed-wing aircraft, UAVs or other lightweight aerospace systems is a plus
• Knowledge of EASA regulations and guidance material for UAS and eVTOL development, such as SORA, SC Light-UAS or SC-VTOL, is a valuable asset
• Experience with structural compliance demonstration, certification documentation and coordination with certification authorities adds to your profile
• Familiarity with finite element and design tools such as ANSYS, Nastran, Abaqus, Siemens NX or comparable software strengthens your application
• Experience with composite manufacturing processes, bonded joints and mechanically fastened joints is an advantage
• Planning and conducting structural test campaigns, from test definition and readiness through execution and data evaluation, is something you have done before
• Experience in building up or growing an engineering team, including hiring and mentoring, rounds out your qualifications
• German language skills are an advantage

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company ev
